title: Bitcoin (BTC) 📉 -1.9%

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What might Bitcoin's future look like if its current decline signals a broader shift in trust or technology?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Scalability solutions like Lightning Network and Layer 2 are enabling faster, cheaper transactions, but adoption remains uneven.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Centralization risks emerge as mining power consolidates — undermining Bitcoin's original decentralized vision.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source tools and community-driven nodes are helping distribute power more equitably across the network.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If governance evolves toward more inclusive models, Bitcoin could become a truly global, decentralized financial standard.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The path ahead will test Bitcoin’s ability to balance innovation with the values that first made it revolutionary.
